answer: Use a micro-batch with a 10 second trigger on the batch engine the team already runs, reading the order event log. The consumer acts on about a 1 minute latency, so a 10 second trigger with a run time of a few seconds lands p99 well under the minute. Record-at-a-time streaming would add a second runtime with its own state and checkpoints, which the team would have to operate and page on, and the 1 minute SLA does not need it. Keep a nightly batch over the same log for finance totals. Caveat: a stream still runs overnight with nobody on call, so confirm the micro-batch job can fail and rerun safely before relying on it.
